Dear Sir / Madam, 
 
Sub: Intimation under Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Lis ting Obligations and Disclosure 
Requirements) Regulations, 2015 
 
We wish to inform you that based on the recommendation of the Nomination & Remuneration 
Committee, the Board of Directors of the Bank has today i.e. April 8, 2025, approved the inclusion of 
Mr. Sanjay D’Souza – Group Head-Emerging & Informal Micro Enterprises Group as part of the Senior 
Management of the Bank with immediate effect. 
 
A brief profile of Mr. Sanjay D’Souza is attached herewith as Annexure-I. 
 
This is for your information and appropriate dissemination. 
 
Thanking you, 
 
Yours faithfully, 
 
For HDFC Bank Limited 
 
 
 
Ajay Agarwal
